address: 945 Estrada Street, Malate, Manila - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: With tiled walls and graffiti art, this vibrant eatery exudes playfulness. A Frida Kahlo mural hints at the casual Mexican menu. Enjoy crispy and soft flour tortilla tacos with beef barbacoa or pork carnitas, perfectly paired with a horchata featuring sweet vanilla and cinnamon notes.
